description: Both crates are listed in Cargo.toml (and pull into Cargo.lock) but no code in this commit or any existing stoa-mail module imports from them. Future reader of Cargo.toml will waste time inferring what they are used for. Causes unnecessary compile-time cost and transitive dep churn. Remove until they are actually used.
title: jmap-mail-types and jmap-mail-server deps added but unused
